raw.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.
Mission: Define the Battleground. Own the Win.
Saviynt isn’t just playing the Identity game; we’re rewriting the rules for the AI era. With a recent $700M investment led by KKR, we are positioned to dominate the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) landscape.
We don’t need a librarian to archive competitor news. We need a Strategic Operator. Reporting directly to the SVP of Strategy, you will be the primary architect of our enterprise-wide competitive offensive. You will translate raw intelligence into structured market execution—equipping our global sales force to dismantle adversaries and secure our position as the undisputed leader in identity security.
This role requires phenomenal identity and access management experience, communication skills, the ability to create high-impact content, and strong cross-functional influence.
You won't just sit in the background; you are the bridge between Product, Sales, and the C-Suite.

The Core Mandate:

    What You Will Do You will be the architect of Saviynt’s competitive edge, interfacing with a cross-functional elite team of Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders.
  • Orchestrate the Offensive: Lead a cross-functional initiative to deliver high-quality competitive analysis and enablement deliverables for Sales, SEs, and Partners.
  • Weaponize Content: Author and publish high-impact thought leadership, competitive analysis, and industry position papers that elevate our brand and reshape customer perception.
  • The Voice of Saviynt: Deliver phenomenal presentations and keynote speeches at global internal and external events, representing our vision to the world.
  • Strategic Influence: Structure sophisticated problems and analyze opportunities to drive meaningful recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain the "source of truth" for all competitive initiative content, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across the organization.

    • Your Arsenal: Deliverables

    Success in this role is measured by the quality and impact of your strategic output, including:
  • Dynamic Battle Cards: Actionable playbooks that help Sales win in the trenches.
  • Field Guides: Deep-dive manuals for Solution Engineers (SEs) and Partners.
  • Strategic Presentations: High-visibility decks created in partnership with Sales Enablement.
  • Digital Narrative: Compelling web content developed with Product Marketing to expose competitor weaknesses.

What You Bring to the Fight

    This role requires a rare blend of deep technical IAM expertise and high-level business strategy.
  • The IAM Veteran: 10-17 years of experience in competitive intelligence, integration, or consulting within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) space.
  • Subject Matter Authority: Mandatory deep-rooted experience in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA). Experience in PAM, Access Management, or Non-Human Identity (NHI) is a significant differentiator.
  • The Communicator: Phenomenal presentation skills with a track record of keynote-level public speaking.
  • The Strategist: Demonstrated ability to frame complex problems, build operational plans, and drive execution to success.
  • The Influencer: Strong leadership skills to build consensus among senior executives and drive virtual, cross-functional teams.
  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, CS, or Engineering is required; a Master of Business Administration (MBA) is strongly preferred.

Why Saviynt?

Hyper-Growth: We are scaling at a pace few companies ever experience.
AI-First DNA: We aren't "bolting on" AI; it’s the foundation of our platform.
Unmatched Visibility: This role is at the center of our most critical corporate initiatives.

The Bottom Line

This is not a role for the passive. This is for the strategist who loves the "chess match" of a high-stakes deal and the thrill of a market-shifting launch.

Ready to lead the offensive? Let’s talk.

If required for this role, you will:

- Complete security & privacy literacy and awareness training during onboarding and annually thereafter
- Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):
> Data Classification, Retention & Handling Policy
> Incident Response Policy/Procedures
> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures
> Mobile Device Policy
> Account Management Policy
> Access Control Policy
> Personnel Security Policy
> Privacy Policy
Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

raw.description:
What are we looking for?

We’re hiring a Channel Partnerships and Affiliates Lead to build Hercules’ partner distribution engine. You will own partner acquisition, program design, enablement, and performance.

You should be:

  • Commercial: strong at pitching, negotiating, and closing.

  • Systems-minded: you build programs that scale with clean tracking and tight guardrails.

  • Partner-obsessed: you make partners successful with clear enablement and co-marketing.

  • Metrics-driven: you manage partners to sourced signups, revenue, CAC/payback, and quality.

What will you lead?

  • Channel distribution deals: identify targets, build the pitch, negotiate terms, close partnerships

  • Affiliate program: define structure (tiers, incentives, attribution window), recruit affiliates, and scale

  • Tracking + payouts: attribution, fraud prevention, payout rules, and reporting

  • Partner enablement: onboarding, messaging, assets, demo flows, and ongoing support

  • Co-marketing: launches, webinars, newsletters, marketplace listings, and joint announcements

  • Partner pipeline + relationship management: CRM pipeline, cadence, QBRs (quarterly business reviews), renewals/expansions

What skills do we expect you to have?

  • Experience closing and scaling channel partnerships and/or affiliate programs

  • Strong deal execution: outreach, negotiation, contracting, and stakeholder management

  • Strong program design: incentives, guardrails, attribution windows, payout policies

  • Familiarity with affiliate tracking and payout ops (links, UTMs, coupons, postbacks, anti-fraud)

  • Ability to drive partner enablement and co-marketing without heavy internal overhead

  • Strong analytical skills: partner-level performance, cohort quality, and unit economics tracking

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of them are specifically choices that we as a company unique prioritize and so can be learned on the job. However, we do specifically filter for these principles our hiring process:

  1. We move with urgency. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds our learning and delights our customers.

  2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

  3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done. We are politely relentless.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates in US time zones who would be willing/able to travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules’ benefits?

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • User whatever AI tools you’d like (you have an unlimited AI budget)

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?

$100k-$250k + equity (depends on seniority, equity, and location)

Compensation Range: $100K - $200K

For more information on SMPA, visit our website https://www.us.sumitomo-pharma.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

We are currently seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, and experienced individual for the position of Director, Alliance Management. The Director, Alliance Management is responsible for actively managing and optimizing the value of the relationship between Sumitomo Pharma and assigned corporate partners. This position interacts regularly with SMPA and SMP leadership across a range of functions to drive agreed initiatives forward, as well as with key contacts at assigned corporate partners. This position provides organizational leadership to develop and maintain productive partnerships, establishes and implements governance, oversees organizational education and management of contractual obligations and deliverables. The position reports to the Executive Director, Alliance Management.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work with SMPA leadership in all functional areas, as well as assigned corporate partners to set the direction and scope for the partnership annually: identify key activities, timing and responsibilities of both parties
  • Oversee the governance of the partnership agreement including participating in governance committees, working group meetings and facilitating decision making
  • Serve as a central point of contact to streamline communication and meetings between functional areas within SMPA and across assigned corporate partners
  • Develop and cultivate strong relationships directly and through Sumitomo leadership with key contacts at assigned corporate partners to create cross-company alignment and resolve disputes
  • Work diligently to mitigate the risk of relationship crises occurring. As necessary, escalate issues that require leadership awareness and attention in a timely manner
  • Monitor adherence to agreement obligations and deliverables and take appropriate action to ensure execution
  • Liaise with legal, finance and functions to ensure that key contract milestones, financial transactions, and progress reports are handled appropriately and provide information/updates/reports as needed
  • Conduct regular reviews/meetings with senior management and functions to communicate key issues, milestones and gather feedback
  • Participate in partner contract negotiations as appropriate and provide input into partnership execution terms of the contract, in particular, governance structures and processes
  • Build expertise about assigned partner companies, including company organization/leadership, strategies, financials, priorities etc; become “internal expert” on assigned corporate partners
  • Proactively suggest process, strategy and prioritization changes or areas of opportunity to SMPA leadership to optimize the value of each assigned relationship.
  • Leverage project management skills to partner with appropriate functional stakeholders focused on partner-related workstreams.

Key Core Competencies

  • Ability to synthesize information from a range of key stakeholders to generate workable solutions to important development and business challenges faced in corporate relationships
  • Track record of building productive relationships enabling effective collaboration and to influence internal and external stakeholders across cross-functional teams to deliver important project and corporate objectives.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable with proactively communicating both orally and in writing with a broad range of audiences and stakeholders, including executive leaders.
  • Ability to proactively identify areas of opportunity to improve processes and relationships to ensure partnerships are operating in an optimal fashion.
  • Strong project management and execution skills to drive forward multiple projects in parallel from implementation, through execution and, ultimately, closure
  • Superior attention to detail that ensures obligations for both parties are adhered to and met within timelines and parameters set forth in all binding agreements
  • Strong problem solving, leadership, negotiation, conflict resolution and influencing skills, particularly outside direct line authority
  • Skilled in understanding and planning in ambiguous situations
  • Effective time management and organization skills
  • Able to multi-task and shift priorities quickly while working under tight timelines
  • PC literacy required; excellent MS Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with planning tools such as Smartsheet
  • High degree of organizational awareness, ability to connect the dots to understand all the interdependency and big picture

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or relevant field
  • Minimum 10 – 15 years (w/o Masters) or 8 – 12 years (with Master’s) of relevant experience in biotech or pharmaceutical industry
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in alliance management leveraging the required skill sets to successfully collaborate with corporate partners in the Biotechnology/Pharmaceutical industry

Base salary is part of our total rewards package which also includes the opportunity for merit-based salary increases, short incentive plan participation, eligibility for our 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances and leaves provided in line with your work state. raw.description:
Hi, we’re Gravie. Our mission is to create health benefits that actually benefit small and midsize businesses and their employees. Our innovative benefit solutions and services are developed and delivered by a diverse group of unique people. We encourage you to be your authentic self - we like you that way.
A Little More About The role:
This role is focused on supporting the operational communications that help members and employers navigate our ICHRA product. You will help our team maintain day-to-day communications workflows, ensure content accuracy, coordinate cross-functional reviews, and support CRM and segmentation updates that keep ICHRA messaging consistent and reliable.
You will report to Gravie’s Product and Member Marketing Leader to scale communications capacity, improve alignment across teams, and ensure clarity in how we communicate enrollment, payments, plan usage, renewals, and ongoing operational updates. Your work will create space for your manager to focus on strategic initiatives, product experimentation, and marketing and member experience improvements.
You will:
  • Support ICHRA segmentation updates, manual data uploads, audience list refreshes, and QA within Braze to support communications developed by your Manager.
  • Support the execution and support of ongoing ICHRA operational campaigns including payments, monitoring workflows, error messaging, and optimization of recurring communications.
  • Support intake, prioritization, and organization of collateral and communication requests from Product, Operations, AM/IM, Gravie Care, Finance, Carrier Relations, and other stakeholders.
  • Conduct periodic audits of ICHRA-facing communications and collateral to ensure accuracy as operations, regulatory requirements, or product features evolve, and implement updates as needed.
  • Assist in the development of new collateral as identified by Manager.
  • Help review and edit communications to support your Manager, as needed, for clarity, tone, and alignment with Gravie’s brand guidelines across member and employer touchpoints.
  • Help support the your Manager with ongoing projects that help support the overall member, employer and product marketing experience.
  • Help shape the communications experience for a fast growing ICHRA benefit portfolio and ensure members and employers receive clear and helpful messaging.
  • Join a team that is scaling quickly and contribute to building communications infrastructure that drives meaningful impact.
You bring:
  • 3+ years of experience in communications, marketing operations, CRM or campaign support, or benefits communications.
  • Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to maintain consistent brand voice across email, digital, and print channels.
  • Experience or comfort working with CRM tools and operational campaign workflows. Braze or similar platforms preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and requests, track intake, and deliver against deadlines.
  • Familiarity with or interest in health benefits communications, employer sponsored plans, and member experience. Understanding of ICHRA is a plus.
  • High attention to detail, especially related to content accuracy, operational alignment, and brand consistency.
  • A proactive mindset with a willingness to ask questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and help build scalable processes.
Extra credit:
  • Some experience in or familiarity with health-benefits communications or regulated industries.
Gravie:
In order to create a more equitable and sustainable future for employer-sponsored health insurance, we need talented people doing amazing work. In exchange, we offer a great overall employee experience with opportunities for career growth, meaningful mission-driven work, and an above average total rewards package.
The salary range for this position is $63,375 - $105,625 annually. Numerous factors including, but not limited to, education, skills, work experience, certifications, etc. will be considered when determining compensation.
Our unique benefits program is the gravy, i.e., the special sauce that sets our compensation package apart. In addition to standard health and wellness benefits, Gravie’s package includes alternative medicine coverage, generous PTO, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, paid holidays, a 401k program, transportation perks, education reimbursement, and paid paw-ternity leave.
A Little More About Us:
  • We know healthcare. Our company was founded and is still led by industry veterans who have started and grown several market-leading companies in the space.
  • We have raised money from top tier investors who share the same long-term vision as we do of building an industry defining company that will endure over the long run. We are well capitalized.
  • Our clients love us. Customer satisfaction rates among employees using Gravie health plans consistently rank above 80% – nearly 40 points above the industry average.
  • Our culture is unique. We tend to be non-hierarchical, merit-driven, opinionated but kind people who thrive working in a high-performance, fast-paced environment. People at Gravie care deeply about making a positive impact in the lives of the people we serve. We may not be the right place for everybody, but if you get energized by doing work every day that focuses on putting consumers at the front of the line, we could be a great place for you. It takes unique people and diverse perspectives to deliver our results. We encourage you to be your authentic self – we like you that way.

raw.description:
Business Development Representative – Teya Portugal

Olá! Somos a Teya.

A Teya é uma empresa de pagamentos e software que ajuda as pequenas empresas a crescer.

Acreditamos que o comércio local é o coração das nossas comunidades — e estamos aqui para lhes dar as ferramentas e o apoio que merecem para competir com os grandes players.

A Teya é uma das fintechs de crescimento mais rápido em Portugal, capacitando milhares de empresas locais todos os dias. Estamos a expandir a nossa equipa de Vendas Internas e procuramos pessoas motivadas, comunicativas e focadas em resultados para se juntarem a nós.

Se gosta de falar com pessoas, prospera num ambiente de ritmo acelerado e quer crescer numa empresa que está a remodelar o setor de pagamentos — este é o seu lugar.

A nossa cultura:

Estes são os 5 valores que definem como trabalhamos juntos todos os dias:

· PROUD TO SERVE: We stand for small, local businesses;

· BUILD FROM THE FUTURE: We build the future today;

· SIMPLICITY: We are seamless and powered by tech;

· WINNING MINDSET: We set very high standards for everything we do;

· ONE DREAM. ONE TEAM. ONE CULTURE. ONE VOICE: We are stronger together.

A tua missão:

Temos uma oportunidade entusiasmante para integrar a nossa equipa comercial em rápido crescimento em Portugal.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Identificação de Clientes – Identificar proativamente potenciais clientes na tua área através de prospecção presencial, contactos, networking e referências;

  • Construção de Relações – Interagir presencialmente com clientes atuais e potenciais para compreender os seus desafios, estabelecer empatia e criar confiança, proporcionando uma experiência positiva;

  • Fecho de Vendas – Utilizar estratégias de vendas eficazes para conquistar novos negócios e atingir os teus objetivos;

  • Conhecimento de Produto – Tornar-te um especialista em tudo o que é Teya e conhecer profundamente os nossos produtos (não te preocupes, vais receber muita formação!);

  • Feedback de Mercado – Colaborar com o resto da empresa, fornecendo informações valiosas do terreno para ajudar a melhorar os nossos produtos;

  • Fidelização de Clientes – Nutrir proativamente relações duradouras com os clientes, identificando oportunidades de venda adicional e cruzada de soluções Teya para maximizar o valor e retenção dos clientes;

  • Representação da Marca – Serás o representante da Teya e a pessoa de referência na tua área, incorporando os nossos valores e visão.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

• Desempenhará funções externas para angariar novos clientes na área de atuação;

· Participará nas reuniões matinais diárias da equipa para definir planos, metas e partilhar aprendizagens;

· Gerir uma carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda;

  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

A tua missão não é apenas fechar muitos negócios, mas também criar parcerias duradouras e contribuir para a satisfação e sucesso dos nossos clientes, compreendendo verdadeiramente as suas necessidades.

O teu perfil:

Procuramos pessoas extraordinárias com os seguintes atributos:

  • Paixão por apoiar pequenas empresas e negócios em crescimento;

  • Preferência por trabalhar num ambiente dinâmico e acelerado;

  • Ótima comunicação e capacidade de transmitir ideias de forma clara;

  • Ótima gestão de tempo e organização;

  • Habilidade em negociação e abordagem comercial;

  • Espírito proativo e ambição de ir além do “bom” para alcançar o “excelente”;

  • Bom espírito de equipa;

  • Forte resiliência e capacidade de ultrapassar objeções;

  • Vontade de aprender e desenvolver competências, com paixão por tecnologia e produtos digitais;

  • Trabalhar de forma orientada a resultados e metas.

Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em funções de contacto com o cliente ou vendas;

  • Fluência em português (o inglês é uma mais-valia);

  • Carta de condução válida e viatura própria.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Lisboa

O que oferecemos:

• Salário base competitivo e bónus atrativo.

• Formação inicial e contínua sobre produtos, técnicas e ferramentas de venda.

• Ambiente de trabalho amigável, colaborativo e dinâmico.

• Plano de saúde

• Subsídio de alimentação

• 25 dias de férias anuais

• Eventos e atividades regulares da equipa

• Oportunidades reais de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento de carreira.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
Job Overview
    We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant to join our pool. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and analyzing financial statements, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and managing budgets and forecasts. You will also conduct audits, provide tax-related services, and advise on financial planning and strategy to support the company's financial health and growth.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Prepare and analyze financial statements and reports to ensure accuracy and completeness.
    • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, regulations, and company policies.
    • Conduct audits and establish internal controls to safeguard company assets.
    • Prepare tax returns and ensure timely and accurate tax compliance.
    • Provide financial planning advice and strategic recommendations based on analysis.
    • Manage budgets, track expenditures, and assist with forecasting future financial performance.
    • Offer insights on improving financial performance, reducing costs, and increasing profitability.

    Essential Skills

    • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and financial regulations.
    • Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, and auditing.
    • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) and Microsoft Excel.
    • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial data.
    • Effective communication skills to interact with both internal teams and external stakeholders.
    • Ability to work independently while adhering to deadlines and compliance standards.

    Salary: ₱30,000 - ₱65,000

    *Please note that this job post does not guarantee immediate client onboarding. Once you successfully complete the entire recruitment process, your profile will be added to our talent pool. This means your profile will be considered for future client opportunities that match your skills and experience.
